posts.title: Huawei unveils Xingchi brand to target mainstream L2 assisted driving market
posts.summary:
Xingchi will focus on L2 assisted driving for the mainstream mass market, while Qiankun ADS will primarily target autonomous driving in the future.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Huawei's Newcool subsidiary launched 'Xingchi,' a new brand dedicated to mainstream L2 assisted driving, to complement its high-end Qiankun ADS autonomous driving brand.
The Xingchi system shares the same WEWA architecture, cloud computing power, and R&D standards as Qiankun ADS, ensuring consistent safety and reliability across both tiers.
Over 10 new vehicle models from partners including Changan, SAIC-GM-Wuling, and GAC are expected to feature the Xingchi system starting in 2027.
Newcool is scaling its R&D investment to 20 billion yuan for 2026, with cloud computing capacity projected to reach 60 EFLOPS to support its dual-brand strategy.

posts.title: Xiaomi files for updated SU7 Ultra with 1,138 kW tri-motor powertrain, 5-seat and 2-seat options
posts.summary:
The updated SU7 Ultra retains its tri-motor all-wheel-drive system with a filed top speed of 318 km/h.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Xiaomi has filed for an updated SU7 Ultra, maintaining its powerful 1,138 kW tri-motor all-wheel-drive system while introducing new dimension and seating configurations.
The updated model will offer both 2-seat and 5-seat options, providing more flexibility compared to the current 5-seat-only version.
Regulatory filings indicate the updated vehicle will retain a top speed of 318 km/h and continue to utilize CATL-supplied ternary lithium-ion batteries.
The update includes various exterior configuration options, such as adjustable rear wings and different wheel rim designs, to further customize the high-performance sedan.

posts.title: Nio's Onvo flagship L90 SUV reaches 70,000 deliveries, latest 10,000 take over 4 months
posts.summary:
The Onvo L90's latest 10,000 deliveries slowed from the roughly 3.5 months it took to grow from 50,000 to 60,000 units.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Nio's Onvo L90 flagship SUV reached 70,000 cumulative deliveries, though the pace of growth has slowed significantly, with the latest 10,000 units taking over four months to deliver.
The brand is facing sustained delivery pressure, reporting an 81.55% year-on-year decline in L90 deliveries for October.
Onvo's total monthly deliveries have fallen for three consecutive months, totaling 8,383 units in October, a 51.66% drop compared to the same period last year.

posts.title: Zeekr files for all-electric variant of 8X to expand premium SUV lineup
posts.summary:
The pure electric Zeekr 8X features dual motors with a combined system power of 680 kW and a top speed of 260 km/h.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Zeekr has filed for a pure electric version of its 8X SUV, which will feature a high-performance dual-motor system capable of 680 kW and a top speed of 260 km/h.
The new electric variant will offer 5-seat and 6-seat configurations and utilize ternary lithium-ion batteries produced by a Geely-CATL joint venture.
The expansion into a pure electric 8X follows the success of the plug-in hybrid model, which has achieved over 31,000 cumulative deliveries since its April launch.
Zeekr reported a 12.72% month-on-month decline in October deliveries, marking the brand's first sequential drop after eight months of consistent growth.

posts.title: The Download: Better bionic hands and AI’s natural-gas boom
posts.summary: This is today’s edition of The Download, our weekday newsletter that provides a daily dose of what’s going on in the world of technology. The next generation of bionic hands is here—and they can feel Avi Davidson lost his left hand as a teenager. Since then, he’s cycled through a few prosthetics. But his latest…
bullets: The FCC has approved SpaceX to launch 1 million satellites specifically designed to support data center operations, with deployment required by 2033.

AI-driven power demand is fueling a significant resurgence in natural gas reliance, exemplified by a Louisiana utility increasing its planned gas plants from three to 10 to support a single Meta data center.
Meta reported a 45% year-over-year increase in emissions, highlighting the tension between aggressive AI infrastructure expansion and corporate sustainability targets.

The emergence of orbital data centers and satellite-based computing infrastructure represents a new frontier for tech investment, though it faces regulatory and environmental scrutiny regarding orbital congestion.
